name: Grype
author: McSparrow <support@mcsparrow.eu>
description: Scans container images for vulnerabilities with Anchore's Grype. Covers OS and language packages, runs entirely inside the McHarbor container, and needs no external service. Grype and Trivy draw on overlapping but not identical advisory feeds, so running both is a reasonable arrangement. Configure it in Security > Scanners.
